sn47.10:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ. bhagavā. atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn47.10:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn47.10:2.1: idha bhante ānanda sambahulā bhikkhuniyo cutūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷāraṃ pubbenāparaṃ visesaṃ sañjānantīti.
sn47.10:2.3: yo hi koci bhaginiyo bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
sn47.10:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
sn47.10:3.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.10:4.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena aññataro bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisiṃdiṃ.
sn47.10:4.2: atha kho bhante sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho bhante tā bhikkhuniyo maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn47.10:4.3: idha bhante ānanda sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo uḷāraṃ pubbenāparaṃ visesaṃ sañjānantīti.
sn47.10:4.4: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante tā bhikkhuniyo etadavocaṃ
sn47.10:4.6: yo hi koci bhaginiyo bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ uḷāraṃ pubbenāparaṃ visesaṃ sañjānissatīti.
sn47.10:5.2: yo hi koci ānanda bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto viharati tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
sn47.10:6.2: idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.10:6.3: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato kāyārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattaṃ bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati.
sn47.10:6.4: tena ānanda bhikkhunā kismiñci deva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabbaṃ.
sn47.10:6.5: tassa kismiñci deva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahato pāmujjaṃ jāyati
sn47.10:6.11: yassa khvāhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
sn47.10:6.13: so paṭisaṃharati ceva na ca vitakketi na ca vicāreti
sn47.10:6.14: avitakkomhi avicāro ajjhattaṃ satimā sukhamasmīti pajānāti.
sn47.10:7.3: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.10:7.4: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato dhammārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho cetaso vā līnattaṃ bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati.

sn47.10:7.15: avitakkomhi avicāro ajjhattaṃ satimā sukhamasmīti pajānāti.
sn47.10:7.16: evaṃ kho ānanda paṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti.
sn47.10:8.2: bahiddhā ānanda bhikkhu cittaṃ appaṇidhāya appaṇihitaṃ me bahiddhā cittanti pajānāti

sn47.10:9.1: iti kho ānanda desitā mayā paṇidhāya bhāvanā desitā mayā appaṇidhāya bhāvanā.
sn47.10:9.2: yaṃ ānanda satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
sn47.10:9.3: etāni ānanda rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyathānanda mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
sn47.10:10.2: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
